source_classes: Official publisher/journal pages for scope, article formats, fees and submission policies.
Index owner and versioned official catalogs for coverage or rank claims.
Scholarly metadata APIs for discovery and DOI/ISSN metadata, within their actual remit.
Aggregators and community reports for clearly attributed leads or experience samples.
Local user-supplied catalogs only with license/access provenance; no unlicensed redistribution.
academic_boundaries: No submission or acceptance outcome guarantee.
Do not equate lower quartiles, OA model, low fees or high publication volume with easier acceptance or poor integrity.
Do not treat a model panel as independent human screening or actual journal peer review.
Unknown is separate from failed filters; citations do not establish that a source supports a claim until checked.
Use source-level evidence quality for reviews; journal rank alone is not a study inclusion or evidence-quality criterion.
Sensitive author declarations and external communications require actual facts and existing user authorization.
